arms_A0_A1_A2_A3_availability_rules.A0: COUPLING_BASELINE; current formal integrated 3D PW inputs only; always required when labels are valid
arms_A0_A1_A2_A3_availability_rules.A1: NP_LF_PHYSICS; legal only when the frozen provider returns provenance-tagged LF values for every paired geometry×wavelength row; no ordering permutation, interpolation, or fallback
arms_A0_A1_A2_A3_availability_rules.A2: NP_FROZEN_LEARNED_SCALAR; legal only when provider parity is formally PASS and the frozen interface declares reproducible runtime availability; otherwise SKIP with the exact reason
arms_A0_A1_A2_A3_availability_rules.A3: NP_LF_AND_LEARNED; legal only when A1 and A2 are both available on the exact A0 rows; compare incrementally against A1

A1.order: 445,446,...,455 nm; P_XLIKE only for current Coupling branch; ux=0; ky=0

feature_field_identities.A2: only the frozen learned scalar response explicitly declared reproducibly callable by the NP authority
feature_field_identities.A3: A1 fields concatenated with the exact A2 scalar field; no other engineered fields

preprocessing.baseline_geometry: D1..D6 ordered; divide by 130 nm; StandardScaler fit on training geometries only
preprocessing.NP_arm_capacity_control: concatenate only authorized NP features; fit StandardScaler then PCA to six input components on each training fold only, preserving the frozen 6-input width-32 model capacity; no test-fit transformation
preprocessing.state_target: seven order-local rank-2 PCA bases fitted on training geometries only; inverse transform for scoring
preprocessing.P_scale: RBF Kernel Ridge with StandardScaler for X/y fit on training geometries only; alpha in {0.1,1,10}, gamma in {0.1,1}; 3-fold grouped inner selection
preprocessing.missing_or_unsupported: fail closed; no fill, interpolation, extrapolation, sorting, or symmetry substitution

geometry_split_philosophy.inner: 3-fold geometry-grouped validation inside each outer training set

current_target_schema.state: integrated 3D PW POSTNP; original C_PW / C_hat factorization; seven order-local rank-2 spectral latents; deterministic H2 decoder
current_target_schema.scale: POSTNP_TOTAL_POWER_V2 / P_scale; predicted, never oracle substituted
current_target_schema.polarization: P_XLIKE only; no P/S averaging or fabricated S target

paired: win/tie/loss for each legal NP arm

acceptance_logic.supported: at least one legal NP arm improves both state and routing median RMSE by >=5%, wins on >=60% of geometries for both endpoints (12/20 for 20G; 20/32 for 32G), and does not worsen state/routing q95 by >10% or worst-case error by >25%; key absolute-order and total-power medians/q95 must not materially degrade; report OOD strata and seed stability
acceptance_logic.partial: measurable but target-specific/small improvement, OOD-stratum sensitivity, or unstable q95/worst-case behavior
acceptance_logic.not_supported: no meaningful incremental improvement or consistent degradation
acceptance_logic.blocked: formal matched labels/provider values are insufficient or fail integrity/coverage gates
acceptance_logic.production_H1_is_separate: all frozen conjunctive H1 gates must pass; feature utility never implies production admission

ood_analysis_rule.distance: sqrt(sum(((D_i-g_i)/130 nm)^2)) over ordered HF22 geometries
ood_analysis_rule.strata: stable sort by (distance, case_id), split nearest/middle/farthest thirds (7/7/6 for 20; analogous thirds for 32)
ood_analysis_rule.use: diagnostics/stratification only; never a model feature
ood_analysis_rule.exact_match_and_extrapolation_counts: report from frozen support authority; no interpolation
